profile.headline: ML @ Google (YouTube) | prev MLE @ Adobe | LLM post-train/inference, RecSys/Ranking, MLSys
profile.summary:
I'm an MLE, focus on LLM fine-tuning and inference, Recommendation Systems, and ML system. Reach me via quanhn232@gmail.com.

Tools include:
- ML/MLOps: PyTorch/Tensorflow, Hugging Face, DeepSpeed, vLLM, Transformers
- Distributed System: Ray, Spark, Kafka, HDFS
- Cloud & Ops: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm

I *do not* work with RAG, AI Agents.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
positions.description:
[ LLM Post-training, Inference & ML System ]
- Fine-tuned (SFT and distillation) LLM to compress knowledge using QLoRA + FSDP
- Deployed LLM for inference on Google TPU, establishing a cost-efficient alternative to GPUs
- Rebuilt data pipeline Spark with Ray Data, managed via Airflow
- Managed Ray Cluster for large-scale jobs like data processing, inference on CPU/GPU
- Consolidated CI/CD (GitHub Actions + Terraform + Helm) and monitoring (Grafana + Prometheus)
